introduce: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Put your arms flat at your sides. \n\nThen lift your butt up and down.
name: BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: This workout should be done on a mat.
Keep your feet around shoulder width apart.
Exhale when lifting your butt, and inhale when lowering it.
This exercise really works on your glutes.
This exercise strengthens your lower back.

introduce:
Start on hands and knees. Put your knees and toes together.

Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale, sit your hips back to your heels, arms reaching forward. Rest your forehead, soften your elbows, and lower your chest close to the floor.

Breathe slowly through your nose; with each exhale, release and sink a little deeper.

If you find this difficult, try bringing your knees slightly apart; listen to your body and find what feels best.
name: CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please make sure there is enough space between your shoulders and ears.
Please keep your arms stretched forward as you sit back.
This exercise gently stretches your upper back, shoulders, hips and legs.
Inhale to allow your belly to expand into your thighs. Exhale to soften into the pose.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your right leg and use your left hand to pull your right knee to the left. Extend your right arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your legs extended. 

Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale slowly to lift your left leg and use your right hand to pull your left knee to the right. Extend your left arm to the side, palm down.

Breathe naturally. Hold this position for a few seconds. With each exhale, soften and deepen the twist.
name: SPINE LUMBAR TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your opposite arm always flat on the floor.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your spine.
Inhale to lengthen the spine. Exhale to deepen the twist and relax.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your right knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your right side with your head resting on your right arm and knees bent. \n\nLift your left knee upwards while keeping your heels touching, then go back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CLAMSHELL LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your pelvis and torso stable during the exercise.
Engage your core to keep your lumbar spine neutral.
Exhale as you lift the top knee up, and inhale as you lower it.
This exercise strengthens your glutes and thighs.

introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat on the ground hip-width apart and your arms straight by your sides. \n\nLift your hips up off the ground into a butt bridge position. Lift one knee up towards your chest, and then lower it back without dropping your hips. Switch sides, and repeat the exercise.
name: MARCHING HIP RAISES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees.
Squeeze your glutes as you lift your hips.
Please don\'t tuck your chin.
Exhale through your mouth as you raise one leg off the ground.
Inhale through your nose as you lower the leg down.

introduce:
Lie on your stomach with your legs extended and your arms by your sides. 

As you inhale, lift your head, chest, arms, and legs off the ground, firming your shoulder blades onto your back. Imagine someone grasping your hands, gently pulling you back, to come up higher.

Hold this position. Use the inhale to support the lift of your head, chest, arms, and legs.
name: LOCUST POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your pubic bone on the floor when lifting your legs.
Inhale to lift higher. Exhale to release your tension.
This exercise tones your buttocks and strengthens your back muscles.

introduce:
Lie flat on a mat, extend your legs at an angle from the mat. Engage your core, lift your shoulders off the mat with arms straight by your ears, shoulder-width apart. Inhale to prepare.

Exhale, bend your knees towards your chest as you sweep your arms out to the sides, reaching around to grasp your shins or ankles and squeeze.

Inhale, reach your arms over your head and keep your legs long.

Repeat the exercise.
name: DOUBLE LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your shoulders lifted.
Please keep your core engaged.
This exercise can stabilize your core muscles.
This exercise helps with your abdominal strength.
Exhale as you bend your knees towards your chest.
Inhale as you extend your arms overhead and keep your legs long.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back, and bend your knees into the chest. Place your hands behind your head to support your head with your fingertips.

Lift your head, neck, and shoulders off the mat, engaging your abdominal muscles.

Extend your right leg out straight into the air while simultaneously rotating your upper body to bring your right elbow towards your left bent knee. 

Switch your legs as you bring your left elbow toward your right knee. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: PILATES CRISS CROSS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do not strain your neck and head.
Please keep your core tight.
Please do not hold your breath.
Please keep the elbows wide.
Please make sure your pelvis is stable.
This exercise helps you build strong obliques and a more defined waistline.

introduce:
Lie flat on a mat, extend your leg straight toward the ceiling.

Inhale, circle your left leg towards your right thigh, straight down but cannot be flat against the mat. 

Exhale and lift up to the start position.

Repeat and reverse the exercise in the opposite direction.
name: SINGLE LEG CIRCLES LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep the toes of your left leg pointed.
Please keep your move within the frame of your body.
This exercise works on the stability of your pelvis.
Inhale as you circle your left leg downward.
Exhale as you lift the leg back up.

introduce:
Lie flat on a mat, draw your right knee in towards the chest and then extend your leg straight toward the ceiling.

Inhale, circle your right leg towards your left thigh, straight down but cannot be flat against the mat. 

Exhale and lift up to the start position.

Repeat and reverse the exercise in the opposite direction.
name: SINGLE LEG CIRCLES RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep the toes of your right leg pointed.
Please keep your move within the frame of your body.
This exercise works on the stability of your pelvis.
Inhale as you circle your right leg downward.
Exhale as you lift the leg back up.

introduce:
Lean back on your tailbone, lengthen your legs up and hold light on your ankles with your hands.

Inhale, engage your core and roll backward onto your shoulders. Exhale and roll up to the starting position.

Repeat the exercise.
name: OPEN LEG ROCKER

tips.text: Please keep your legs shoulder-width apart.
Please do not roll onto your neck and head.
Please control your roll and your return.
Please make sure your hands are holding your legs.
This exercise can stretch the back and hamstrings.
Inhale as you engage your core and roll backward.
Exhale as you roll back up to the starting position.

introduce:
Start with a straight arm plank with your legs and feet together. 

Exhale, lift one leg up as high as you can with your foot pointed. Inhale as you lower your leg back to the start position. 

Switch your legs and repeat the exercise.
name: LEG PULL FRONT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do not drop your hips.
Please keep your legs stretched.
Please make sure your trunk is stable as you move your leg.
This exercise helps improve stability in the shoulders and trunk.
It's a great exercise to train your legs, hamstrings, back, abdominals, shoulders, and arms.
Exhale as you lift one leg and inhale as you lower your leg back.
Continue breathing smoothly and avoid holding your breath.

introduce:
Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms reaching overhead. Keep your legs together and your toes pointed. Inhale to prepare. 

Exhale, begin to slowly peel your spine off the mat, one vertebra at a time until your body is in a seated position, with your arms reaching towards your toes.

Inhale at the top, and as you exhale, slowly begin to roll back down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: ROLL UP

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please initiate the movement from your core, instead of your arms.
This exercise can strengthen abdominal muscles.
Inhale at the top while reaching towards your toes.
Exhale as you slowly roll back down, maintaining control.
